trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn all 54 other trophies — the platinum pops with the last one.

steps.t: Follow the roadmap in order: story first, then activities, then cleanup.
Only Positive Mental Attitude can be missed — meditate at all 18 spots before the story ends.
The last trophy is usually A Long Road (100%) or a grind trophy; the platinum pops with it.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing.

steps.t: Gone Fishing is the first mission — it opens the game.
Follow the on-screen prompts through the fishing sequence.
The trophy pops the moment the mission completes.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1.

steps.t: Play through every mission in Chapter 1 in order.
Chapter trophies pop at the chapter's end — no side content needed.
If it does not pop, replay the chapter's last mission.

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2.

steps.t: Play through every mission in Chapter 2 in order.
Chapter trophies pop at the chapter's end — no side content needed.
If it does not pop, replay the chapter's last mission.

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 3.

steps.t: Play through every mission in Chapter 3 in order.
Chapter trophies pop at the chapter's end — no side content needed.
If it does not pop, replay the chapter's last mission.

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4.

steps.t: Play through every mission in Chapter 4 in order.
Chapter trophies pop at the chapter's end — no side content needed.
If it does not pop, replay the chapter's last mission.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission after Chapter 4.

steps.t: The final mission unlocks after Chapter 4 is complete.
Finish it to pop the gold — the story's last trophy.
After the credits, free roam stays open for cleanup.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Breakfast Run.

steps.t: Breakfast Run is a story mission — it appears in the mission flow.
Play through it; there is no special requirement.
Mission trophies pop on completion.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission The Cartel Heist.

steps.t: The Cartel Heist is a story mission — it appears in the mission flow.
Play through it; there is no special requirement.
Mission trophies pop on completion.

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Child's Play.

steps.t: Child's Play is a story mission — it appears in the mission flow.
Play through it; there is no special requirement.
Mission trophies pop on completion.

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Headliners.

steps.t: Headliners is a story mission — it appears in the mission flow.
Play through it; there is no special requirement.
Mission trophies pop on completion.

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission VCIA Takedown.

steps.t: VCIA Takedown is a story mission — it appears in the mission flow.
Play through it; there is no special requirement.
Mission trophies pop on completion.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Operation Savage Glory.

steps.t: Operation Savage Glory is a story mission — it appears in the mission flow.
Play through it; there is no special requirement.
Mission trophies pop on completion.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion — story, activities, collectibles, challenges.

steps.t: 100% counts story missions, stranger strands, activities, collectibles and challenges.
The in-game stats page tracks your completion percentage — check it often.
Finish all story missions and all 8 stranger strands first.
Clear the activity checklists: stunts, races, shooting range, drone races.
Collectibles count too — card sets, WAiNK spots, discovered vehicles.
The trophy pops at exactly 100%; if it does not, re-check the stats page for the missing line.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts — jumps, drifts, near-misses, airtime.

steps.t: A stunt is a jump, near-miss, drift or airtime moment — the game counts it on the HUD.
The Vice City airport runway and the long causeway bridges are the best stunt spots.
Use a fast bike: wheelies and jumps chain stunts together.
Stunts count in free roam, so grind them between missions.
Near-misses at speed count too — weave through traffic on the highway.
The stepper in this guide tracks your count — tap + as you go.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types once — fishing, bowling, arcade, range, drones, racing, hunting, meditation, gym.

steps.t: The activities menu lists the 9 types — do one of each.
Fishing, bowling and the arcade are the quickest three to tick off.
The shooting range and drone races each count as one type.
Meditation counts too — one spot is enough for this trophy.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold all 42 Shooting Range challenges.

steps.t: There are 42 Shooting Range challenges across the ranges in Leonida.
Each challenge needs a gold medal — silver is not enough.
Match the weapon to the challenge: pistol for precision, SMG for speed.
Aim for the head on target drills — headshots score far more.
Restart a challenge instantly on a bad run; there is no penalty.
The range tracks your medals per challenge — clear the un-golded ones last.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations.

steps.t: There are 14 Top Fun drone race locations across Leonida.
Win at least once at each location — the map marks the ones you have won.
Cut corners on the course — the checkpoint rings are generous.
Learn each course with a slow first lap, then race it properly.
Use the boost on the long straights, never in the tight turns.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — each race counts once.

steps.t: Win 20 different races — replays of the same race do not count twice.
Street races, off-road races and boat races all count.
The race menu shows which ones you have already won.
Pick short circuit races first — they are the fastest wins.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.

steps.t: Cal challenges you to a fishing duel — find him at the fishing spots.
The challenge is a timed catch: most weight wins.
Reel steadily and do not let the line snap on the big ones.
If you lose, challenge him again — there is no lockout.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game at any arcade.

steps.t: Arcades are in Vice City and the malls — walk up to a cabinet.
Any arcade game counts; pick the shortest one.
The trophy pops when the game ends, win or lose.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's last mission.

steps.t: Andy's mission strand ends with his final mission — follow his marker.
Play through it; there is no special requirement.
Character-final trophies pop on completion.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's last mission.

steps.t: Kenton's mission strand ends with his final mission — follow his marker.
Play through it; there is no special requirement.
Character-final trophies pop on completion.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's last mission.

steps.t: Billy's mission strand ends with his final mission — follow his marker.
Play through it; there is no special requirement.
Character-final trophies pop on completion.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida.

steps.t: Strangers appear as ? markers on the map — 8 strands in total.
Each strand is several missions; finish the whole strand for it to count.
Strands are spread across Vice City, the Keys and the countryside.
Check the map after each chapter — new strangers appear as the story advances.
The strand counter is in the stats page if you lose track.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's last mission.

steps.t: Randy's mission strand ends with his final mission — follow his marker.
Play through it; there is no special requirement.
Character-final trophies pop on completion.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's last mission.

steps.t: Tyrone's mission strand ends with his final mission — follow his marker.
Play through it; there is no special requirement.
Character-final trophies pop on completion.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots — THE one possibly missable trophy. Do it before the story ends.

steps.t: There are 18 meditation spots across Leonida — this is the one possibly missable trophy.
Do the spots as you explore, before the story's point of no return.
The first spot teaches the meditation prompt; after that, spots are marked on the map.
Meditate at each spot once — sit through the full prompt for it to count.
Coastal and mountain spots are the easiest to miss — check the map's unvisited marks.
The stepper here tracks 0 / 18 — tap + at each spot so you never lose count.
If you finish the story first, the spots stay available in free roam — but do not risk it.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for.

steps.t: Bret's hunting strand points you at a unique animal — follow his marker.
Track it with the hunting senses; it only appears in its own territory.
A clean kill with a rifle counts; a messy one can scare it off.
Bring it back to Bret to finish the hunt.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets hidden across Leonida.

steps.t: Collectible cards are hidden across Leonida — in shops, bars and odd corners.
A set is complete when you hold every card in it — 3 sets needed.
The collectibles menu shows which cards you still miss, per set.
Cards glow faintly — check shelves and counters, not just the floor.
Trade duplicates with other players' listings if a card eludes you.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations across Leonida.

steps.t: WAiNK It is the phone photo mode — frame a spot and snap it.
100 different locations count — repeats of the same spot do not.
Landmarks, murals and viewpoints are all WAiNK spots.
The phone marks a spot as WAiNKed once it counts.
Work through the map region by region so none are skipped.
The stepper here tracks 0 / 100 — tap + at each new spot.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Finish 50 challenges from the challenges menu.

steps.t: Challenges are listed in the challenges menu — combat, driving, exploration and more.
Any 50 count; pick the short ones first (5 kills, 10 near-misses).
Challenges complete passively as you play — check the menu between missions.
The menu shows progress per challenge, so chase the nearly-done ones.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, hit 4 stars, then lose the cops.

steps.t: Bring your partner along, then raise your wanted level to 4 stars.
Lose the cops while your partner is still with you — the trophy needs them present.
Break line of sight, then hide — alleys and parking garages work best.
A fast car helps: outrun the search radius, then stay quiet.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops in a row with your partner — and keep your wanted level the whole time.

steps.t: Bring your partner, then rob a shop to raise your wanted level.
Rob two more shops back-to-back WITHOUT losing the wanted level.
The trick is to keep the heat: do not hide between shops.
Pick three shops close together in Vice City so the run is short.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles — drive or enter each one.

steps.t: Entering or driving a vehicle marks it discovered.
100 different vehicles count — the vehicles menu tracks your total.
Car parks, docks and the airport hold the rare ones.
Traffic variety changes by district — cruise each area.
The stepper here tracks 0 / 100 — tap + for each new discovery.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies in one Combat Focus.

steps.t: Combat Focus slows time — trigger it when enemies cluster.
A shotgun or SMG clears a group fastest inside the window.
Ambush a group in the open — five in one window needs them close.
If the window ends early, retry — there is no cooldown penalty.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Leave VCIA in an unscheduled way — steal a plane and take off.

steps.t: Go to VCIA airport and get onto the tarmac.
Steal a parked plane and take off — no flight plan, no clearance.
A small prop plane is easiest to reach and to lift off.
The trophy pops once you are airborne and clear of the runway.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Get inside a Rhino tank — and survive the heat that follows.

steps.t: Rhinos are the military tanks — they appear at high wanted levels.
Raise your wanted level until a Rhino rolls in, then hijack it.
Board it from the side while it is slow — the hatch is the weak point.
Once inside, the trophy pops — the tank's cannon is yours.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store — no alarms, no one spotting you.

steps.t: Pick a jewelry store and case it first — note the cameras and guards.
Go in masked and quiet; smash-and-grab sets off the alarm.
Avoid the camera cones — one spot ruins the run.
Leave clean and the trophy pops outside the store.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time.

steps.t: Bank vaults are the big robberies — plan the approach and the escape.
Five vaults in total; each counts once it is robbed and you escape.
Park a fast getaway car two streets away before you go in.
Vault alarms bring the police fast — leave the moment the cash is bagged.
The vault list is in the heist menu once the first is unlocked.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and get away.

steps.t: Armored trucks run set routes through Vice City — watch for them.
Block the truck, then crack the rear doors.
Grab the cash and escape before the police box you in.
A sticky bomb on the rear door opens it fastest.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida.

steps.t: Leonida has 52 named areas — the map tracks which you have visited.
Drive or walk into each area; the name banner confirms the visit.
The Keys, the swamps and the northern hills hide the last few areas.
Check the map for unnamed gaps — those are the areas you still miss.
A helicopter makes the remote areas far quicker to reach.
The stepper here tracks 0 / 52 — tap + per area banner.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation of each of the 9 gangs.

steps.t: Nine gangs run illegal operations across Leonida — one robbery per gang.
Operations are marked once you scout a gang's turf.
Each gang's operation is different — drugs, guns, smuggling, fronts.
Robbing a gang's operation raises its heat — hit and leave fast.
The gang list in the stats page shows which you have hit.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — no verified method yet. The description points to a cocktail bar on Ocean Beach.

steps.t: UNCONFIRMED: no verified method yet — the community is still testing.
The description points to a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
Likely candidates: the Ocean Beach bars with a sea view — try ordering at the counter.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash a car out through a vehicle showroom's glass.

steps.t: Drive a car into a vehicle showroom, then out through the glass.
Build speed inside the showroom before you hit the window.
The glass front is the exit — aim for the centre pane.
The trophy pops once you are outside with the car.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Bowl at the Kolt & Associates alley — follow through the full game.

steps.t: The Kolt & Associates bowling alley is in Vice City.
Play a full game — follow-through means finishing all frames.
Aim for the pocket and watch the lane oil — it changes the break.
The trophy pops at the end of the game, whatever your score.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership moment with mass appeal — play through the story.

steps.t: This one comes from a story partnership moment.
Play the story — it pops during the partnership beat.
No side content is needed for it.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make 500 choices — dialogue picks and actions add up across the game.

steps.t: PSN tracks a count to 500 — every choice you make adds to it.
Dialogue picks, story choices and action choices all count.
The count climbs passively — a normal playthrough gets most of the way.
Replay missions with different choices to top it up.
The stepper here tracks 0 / 500 — tap + in batches as you choose.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — PowerPyx: currently unknown, believed related to the Payday Loans store from the Prologue.

steps.t: UNCONFIRMED: PowerPyx lists it as currently unknown.
Believed related to the Payday Loans store from the Prologue.
Second time's the charm — the name hints at failing once, then succeeding.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: CONFIRMED — witness the UFO: road NW of Starlet Motel, Kelly County, after 02:00, solo, headlights flashing.

steps.t: CONFIRMED: the UFO appears on the road northwest of Starlet Motel, Kelly County.
Go after 02:00 — the sighting only happens in the small hours.
Go solo — no partner, no passengers.
Flash your car headlights on the road — that is the trigger.
The spawn is somewhat random — if nothing shows, leave and come back another night.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: CONFIRMED — on a motorbike or bicycle, kick 10 pedestrians with Square within 60 seconds, Vice City / Ocean Beach.

steps.t: CONFIRMED: ride a motorbike or bicycle — the kick only works from one.
Kick 10 pedestrians with Square within 60 seconds.
Ocean Beach promenade in Vice City is the best spot — crowds all day.
Keep moving: stop and the timer still runs, so plan the line first.
If the count resets, you were too slow — restart the 60 seconds fresh.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of marked bills through your contacts.

steps.t: Marked bills come from heists and big robberies — they cannot be spent raw.
Launder them through your contacts — each contact takes a cut.
The total is $250,000 laundered, not earned — it adds up across jobs.
Bigger heists drop bigger stacks of marked bills.
Contacts unlock as the story advances — the later ones take a smaller cut.
The stepper here tracks 0 / $250,000 — tap + after each laundering.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — clothes, weapons, cars, food.

steps.t: Every dollar spent in a shop counts — clothes, weapons, cars, food.
The total is $100,000 across all shops, not in one place.
A single expensive car gets you most of the way.
The stepper here tracks 0 / $100,000 — tap + as you buy.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties across Leonida.

steps.t: Eight garage properties are for sale across Leonida.
Buy all 8 — the property menu lists the ones you own.
Garages unlock as the story advances — the last ones need later chapters.
Each garage also stores your vehicles — buy the big ones first.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.

steps.t: Open the Scooter Bros app on your phone to register a vehicle.
Any 10 vehicles count — cars, bikes, boats.
Register each one as you find it — the app lists your registered set.
Stolen vehicles register too, as long as they are yours when you open the app.
